text:
deploy-bot: deploycheck FAILED for release v2026.03.12 — env-parity: secret path mismatch detected between staging and prod. Flagging release and blocking promotion.

deploy-bot: details: /keystore/embeddings-api (staging) vs /keystore/Embeddings-API (prod). Case sensitivity on target filesystem causing missing secret in prod canary.

alice.nguyen: ugh. canary is at ~30% traffic right now, are we seeing errors?

carla (oncall): errors in canary logs: 503s when fetching model embeddings, stack shows KeyNotFound for keystore path.

ben_k: looks like the config-provider (env-shim) normalizes trailing slashes but not case; we missed a migration idempotency test.

infra-bot: observed: tcp retries increased, latency spike ~150ms correlated with 03:17 deploy window.

danielle: options: 1) rollback canary to previous image 2) hotfix to normalize key lookup to lowercase 3) patch deploy metadata to alias path in prod KMS. Thoughts?

evelyn-rm: change window is open for 15 more minutes. If we rollback now it's safest. Hotfix might be quick but risk of another hidden drift.

alice.nguyen: if we rollback canary we should pin the release and open a rollback PR so CI keeps green. I'll prepare the pin.

ben_k: hotfix is small, 4-line change in keystore accessor + unit test. But deploy path would need immediate rollout; if anything goes sideways we'll still be in the same window.

carla (oncall): Can we reduce canary traffic to 0 instead of full rollback? That buys time to validate a hotfix in staging and then promote.

deploy-bot: action suggested: pause promotion, set canary traffic=0, mark release as pinned:v2026.03.12 and create incident ticket.

alice.nguyen: executing: `deployctl promote --set-canary=0 --pin-release=v2026.03.12` (running now).

infra-bot: canary traffic set to 0 — healthchecks returning to baseline.

ben_k: I'll open hotfix PR with lowercase-normalization + migration shim that maps old keys. Will add e2e that simulates mixed-case keys.

danielle: good, after PR merges we run a small canary in the same change window and then unpin. If merge misses window, we rollback fully and schedule hotfix for next window.

evelyn-rm: create release note & changelog line: "Fixed: keystore key normalization to handle case variance between environments". Also add postmortem tag for env-parity.

carla (oncall): created INC-4129 and linked PR #7345. Notifying security for KMS audit since we touched key aliases.

alice.nguyen: done. pin confirmed and ticket created. staging regression tests passed for hotfix locally.

ben_k: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/7345 — adding reviewers @alice.nguyen @carla (oncall).

deploy-bot: release remains blocked until PR merges and canary re-validates.

evelyn-rm: summary: reduce canary -> validate hotfix -> if green, increment canary and unpin in-window. If not, full rollback next 10m. Everyone pls ack. :thumbsup:

alice.nguyen: ack
ben_k: ack
carla (oncall): ack
danielle: ack
evelyn-rm: ack
